chunks: To those who sit at home and say of their brothers: "They would never have been killed had they listened to us, say: "Drive away death from your midst if what you say is true."

key_terms.مَا قُتِلُوا: They would not have been killed

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the hypocrites' claim about their brothers' death in Surah Aal-Imran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse critiques the hypocrites (al-Munafiqun) who attributed the martyrdom of their companions to a lack of obedience, thereby shifting blame from divine decree to human error. God’s rhetorical challenge, 'if you are truthful,' underscores that death is inevitable regardless of strategy, highlighting the futility of their excuse. This reinforces the Shia understanding of martyrdom as a divinely ordained status rather than a mere casualty of war.
